summary.text: One of Penelope's suitors in Apollodorus' catalogue of the fifty-seven wooers from Dulichium — a namesake of Mecisteus son of Talaus in the Theban royal stemma.

story.text: Apollodorus names Mecisteus among the suitors who devoured Odysseus' substance, listed after Diopithes and before Antimachus in the long company of Penelope's wooers.
